api: Full-text search (server-rendered, the data route is the page's React Flight / RSC payload — no dedicated JSON API is exposed): GET https://books.rafed.net/search?q=<query> -> 200 with a result count (عدد النتائج) and up to 15 items in the decoded payload, each item naming one book, its author (the author link's TEXT; the href slug is unreliable), the first hit page inside the book, in how many of the book's pages the term was found, and a <mark>-marked snippet. Book record: GET /view/<book_id> -> schema.org Book metadata + a structured book object (title, author, publisher, page count, the work's parts with their own ids). Book text: GET /view/<book_id>/page/<n> -> the page's real text in the payload's page_data field, either an inline HTML fragment (<div class="pgcontent">...) or a Flight back-reference ($<row>) to a raw text row (<row>:T<hex length>,<raw HTML>) elsewhere in the payload. No key, no login.
name: Rafed Library — مكتبة رافد (مؤسسة آل البيت عليهم السلام لإحياء التراث, books.rafed.net)
notes: LIVE-WIRED §49 (probed 2026-11-26 from the build sandbox, multi-route): مكتبة رافد, the digital library of مؤسسة آل البيت (ع) لإحياء التراث (Qom) — the platform reports 4,172 books, 305 of them collated against printed editions — serving the full text of its books as page-based text through its reader, no login. Routes tried: (1) the home page / answers 200 server-rendered (Next.js), the catalogue genuinely open; (2) the search route GET /search?q=<q> answers 200 with the full-text result list in the RSC payload (الفلك -> 1,291 results; البيروني -> 147; ابن سينا -> 632; a no-match query answers count ٠ with no items); (3) book pages /view/<id> answer 200 with schema.org metadata + the structured book record; (4) reader pages /view/<id>/page/<n> answer 200 and carry the page's real prose in the payload's page_data (book 900 من علم الفلك القرآني pp. 10 and 100 read verbatim; the Shifa parts below likewise); (5) the file store lib.rafed.net/Books/<id>_<slug>/ holds the reader's own files (cover images; a per-book DOC zip named in the book record's download_types) — the reader route is cleaner and complete, so the store is not fetched; (6) the sitemap route /sitemap (robots.txt points to it) is a sitemapindex — catalogue-only, not needed; (7) OAI-PMH /oai?verb=Identify -> 404 on books.rafed.net and on lib.rafed.net — no OAI route exists. PRIMARY SEEDS: the six parts of Ibn Sina's الشفاء ـ طبيعيّات recorded below (ids 3037, 3066, 3068, 3070, 3072, 3075) — each part's title and author are attested by the platform's own book record (book 3037's view page lists all parts with their author) and one page of each part was fetched and read during the probe; candidates from them are marked primary. The work's introduction record (id 3036) is the modern edition's front matter (the platform lists no author for it) and is NOT seeded. NO BIRUNI SEEDS: al-Biruni's own books are NOT hosted here (searches for القانون المسعودي, الآثار الباقية, تحقيق ما للهند and التفهيم return other books MENTIONING them — الذريعة, Krachkovsky's تاريخ الأدب الجغرافي العربي, al-Dhahabi's تاريخ الإسلام among them), so no Rafed candidate is marked primary on his account. Cover pages and scan-only pages carry no machine text (page_data holds only an image + the page number) and are rejected by the shared §46 text bar.
